pages.name: Bright Point
pages.description: Through the eyepiece, you see not a star but a shiny object on a nearby slope. An old map lies on the table.

options.description: Locate it on the map and set out to search

pages.name: Brass Spyglass
pages.description: An old brass telescope lies on the slope, catching a sunbeam.

pages.name: Ordinary Glint
pages.description: After adjusting the telescope, you realize it is only a shard of bottle glass.
